Conversation/0x0100000500003283/Descript.polish: Odznaczony kredą postęp wzrostu dziecka na przestrzeni lat.
Conversation/0x0100000500003283/Descript.belarusian: Адзначаны крэйдай рост дзіцяці на працягу гадоў.

Conversation/0x010000050000328A/Descript.english: The same brand of cigarettes you found in the trash next to the deceased.
Conversation/0x010000050000328A/Descript.polish: Papierosy tej samej marki, co te znalezione w śmieciach przy ciele.
Conversation/0x010000050000328A/Descript.belarusian: Цыгарэты той жа маркі, што і тыя, якія былі знойдзены ў смецці каля цела.

Conversation/0x01000005000038D0/Descript.english: To get to the coast you need to use the panel to close the water lock. It's been blocked, pending repairs, which should be done by Wednesday morning. (This will open up a new area in Martinaise.)
Conversation/0x01000005000038D0/Descript.polish: Aby dostać się na wybrzeże, musisz użyć panelu i zamknąć śluzę. Został on zablokowany i czeka na naprawę – powinna ona dobiec końca w środowy poranek. (Otworzy to nowy obszar w Martinaise).
Conversation/0x01000005000038D0/Descript.belarusian: Каб дабрацца да ўзбярэжжа, ты павінен скарыстацца панэллю і закрыць шлюз. Ён быў заблакаваны і чакае на рамонт – ён павінен скончыцца ў сераду раніцай. (Гэта адкрые новую вобласць у Марцінайсе).

Conversation/0x01000005000038D0/Title.english: Close the water lock on Wednesday

Conversation/0x0100000600007C84/Descript.english: *Went to the village on the coast, officer. See you there! -- Joyce* says the note on the post.
Conversation/0x0100000600007C84/Descript.polish: „Jestem we wsi na wybrzeżu, panie władzo. Do zobaczenia na miejscu! Joyce” – głosi notatka na słupie.
Conversation/0x0100000600007C84/Descript.belarusian: «Я знаходжуся ў вёсцы на ўзбярэжжы, пан капітан. Да сустрэчы на месцы! Джойс» — гаворыцца ў запісцы на слупе.

Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Descript.english: Police officers get *briefed* about the cases they're given. Sometimes they *forget* the briefing, though, and need to be briefed again! Click on Kim and ask him about the case.
Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Descript.polish: Funkcjonariusze policji przechodzą *odprawę* w związku z prowadzonymi śledztwami. Czasem jednak *zapominają* jej treść i muszą ją sobie przypomnieć! Kliknij Kima i spytaj go o szczegóły sprawy.
Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Descript.belarusian: Супрацоўнікі паліцыі праходзяць *інструктаж* у сувязі з праводжанымі расследаваннямі. Часам, аднак, *забываюць* яго змест і мусяць яго сабе нагадаць! Націсніце на Кіма і спытайцеся ў яго пра падрабязнасці справы.

Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Title.english: Ask Kim to tell you about the case
Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Title.polish: Poproś Kima, żeby opowiedział ci o sprawie
Conversation/0x0100000600008499/Title.belarusian: Папрасі Кіма, каб ён расказаў табе пра справу.

Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Descript.english: Go to her room, search it once more. Upstairs, in the bedroom -- the window. Perhaps it will yield *something*?
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Descript.polish: Idź do jej pokoju, przeszukaj go jeszcze raz. Na górze, w sypialni. Okno. Może *coś* tam się znajdzie?
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Descript.belarusian: Ідзі ў яе пакой, перагледзь яго яшчэ раз. Уверсе, у спальні. Вокна. Магчыма, *нешта* там знойдзецца?

Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Title.english: Inspect the window in Klaasje's bedroom
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Title.polish: Przyjrzyj się oknu w sypialni Klaasje
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/Title.belarusian: Паглядзі ў акно ў спальні Клаас'е.

Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/subtask_.english: Perform a thorough ballistics check of the window.
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/subtask_.polish: Przeprowadź dokładne oględziny okna pod kątem balistyki.
Conversation/0x010000060000D9DE/subtask_.belarusian: Правядзіце дэталёвы агляд акна з пункту гледжання балістыкі.

Conversation/0x010000060000E4B0/Descript.english: You should ask the owner before you take this boat to the island.
Conversation/0x010000060000E4B0/Descript.polish: Lepiej spytaj właścicielkę o pozwolenie, zanim zabierzesz jej łódź na wyspę.
Conversation/0x010000060000E4B0/Descript.belarusian: Лепш спытай уласьніцу дазволу, перш чым забіраць яе лодку на выспу.

Conversation/0x010000060000E7D5/Descript.english: Cold air seeps in through the embrasure.
Conversation/0x010000060000E7D5/Descript.polish: Przez ambrazurę wdziera się zimne powietrze.

Conversation/0x010000060000EA10/Descript.english: Go down to the chain, there's something there...
Conversation/0x010000060000EA10/Descript.polish: Idź dalej, do łańcucha, coś tam jest...
Conversation/0x010000060000EA10/Descript.belarusian: Ідзі далей, да ланцуга, нешта там ёсць...

Conversation/0x010000060000EA32/Descript.english: Find the cryptid called the *Insulindian phasmid* in Martinaise -- confirm its existence.
Conversation/0x010000060000EA32/Descript.polish: Znajdź w Martinaise kryptydę zwaną *insulindiańskim straszykiem*. Potwierdź jej istnienie.
Conversation/0x010000060000EA32/Descript.belarusian: Знайдзіце ў Марцінаізе крыптыду пад назвай *інсуліндзянскі страшык*. Пацвердзьце яе існаванне.

Conversation/0x010000060000FE4C/Descript.english: There is an extra special *fourth* substance in Martinaise, that no one talks about. Find it, slurp it. You may even start noticing bottles tucked away in Martinaise once you've seen one in your hand.
Conversation/0x010000060000FE4C/Descript.polish: W Martinaise jest dodatkowa, wyjątkowa *czwarta* substancja, o której nikt nie mówi. Znajdź ją. Wychłepcz. Może kiedy jedna z jej butelek znajdzie się w twojej dłoni, zaczniesz dostrzegać inne, pochowane po okolicy.
Conversation/0x010000060000FE4C/Descript.belarusian: У Мартынэзе ёсць дадатковая, выключная *чацвёртая* рэчыва, пра якое ніхто не гаворыць. Знайдзі яго. Выхлепчы. Магчыма, калі адна з яе бутэлек апынецца ў тваёй руцэ, ты пачнеш заўважаць іншыя, схаваныя вакол.

Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/Descript.english: You have to gain authority in Titus' eyes for the investigation to advance. Soften him up first. Maybe investigate the crime scene, or the body? Look for a witness? Get help from the Union boss, or the company rep? Tie them to any other crimes?
Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/Descript.polish: Musisz zdobyć uznanie w oczach Titusa, aby pchnąć sprawę naprzód. Zmiękcz go trochę. Zbadaj może najpierw miejsce zbrodni lub ciało? Poszukaj świadka? Zapewnij sobie pomoc szefa Związku lub przedstawicielki firmy? Powiąż ich z innymi zbrodniami?
Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/Descript.belarusian: Вы павінны заваяваць прызнанне ў вачах Тытуса, каб зрушыць справу наперад. Змякчыце яго крыху. Можа, спачатку даследуйце месца злачынства або цела? Шукайце сведку? Забяспечце сабе дапамогу кіраўніка Звязу або прадстаўніцы кампаніі? Звяжыце іх з іншымі злачынствамі?

Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/Title.english: Prove your authority to Titus Hardie

Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/subtask_.english: Talk to Titus and establish authority in the Hardie boys' eyes.
Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z Titusem i zdobądź sobie autorytet w oczach chłopaków Hardiego.
Conversation/0x0100000600012E34/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з Тытусам і заваюй аўтарытэт у вачах хлопцаў Хардзі.

Conversation/0x0100000600013458/Descript.english: A melancholy pop song plays on the radio.
Conversation/0x0100000600013458/Descript.polish: W radiu leci melancholijna piosenka popowa.

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/Descript.english: Ruby was in the cinderblock village but left Monday. She could be anywhere on the peninsula, north of the village. Look inside the church. Ask around, there are people to the west of the mural. Or, I don't know... ask a girl on a date? Then ask her? Ask the wind maybe?
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/Descript.polish: Ruby przebywała w pustakowej wsi, lecz opuściła ją w poniedziałek. Poszukaj w kościele. Rozpytaj o nią – na zachód od muralu znajdziesz ludzi. Albo... no nie wiem, zaproś dziewczynę na randkę? A potem ją spytaj? Albo spytaj wiatr, może odpowie?
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/Descript.belarusian: Рубі знаходзілася ў пустой вёсцы, але пакінула яе ў панядзелак. Шукай у царкве. Распытавай пра яе – на захад ад мурала знойдзеш людзей. Альбо... не ведаю, запрасі дзяўчыну на спатканне? А потым спытай яе? Альбо спытай вецер, можа адкажа?

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/Title.english: Look for Ruby on the coast

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Return to the 'Feld' mural and consult the wind if you don't know what to do. Other than that, keep searching the coast.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Wróć do muralu „Feld” i porozmawiaj z wiatrem, jeśli nie wiesz, co zrobić. Poza tym przeszukuj dalej wybrzeże.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Вярніцеся да мурала «Фельд» і пагаварыце з ветрам, калі не ведаеце, што рабіць. Акрамя таго, працягвайце даследаваць узбярэжжа.

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Climb the ladder to the roof -- or find another way into the Feld building.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Wejdź po drabinie na dach albo znajdź inny sposób na dostanie się do budynku Felda.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Узнясіцеся па лесвіцы на дах або знайдзіце іншы спосаб, каб трапіць у будынак Фелда.

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Enter the building and let Kim in too.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Wejdź do budynku i wpuść do niego też Kima.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Зайдзі ў будынак і пусти ў яго таксама Кіма.

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Explore the passages below the Feld building.
Enter the cavern below the Feld building -- when you're ready. (NOTE! Union and cryptozoology business might end when you do.)
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Wejdź do jaskini pod budynkiem Felda, kiedy będziesz gotowy. (UWAGA! Kiedy to zrobisz, mogą zakończyć się sprawy dotyczące Związku i kryptozoologii).
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Уваходзь у пячору пад будынкам Фелда, калі будзеш гатовы. (УВАГА! Калі ты зробіш гэта, могуць завяршыцца справы, якія датычацца Звязу і криптазаалогіі).

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Ruby's gone -- go to her tent.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Ruby nie stanowi już zagrożenia. Idź do jej namiotu.
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Рубі больш не ўяўляе пагрозы. Ідзі да яе палаткі.

Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.english: Look through the magazines in Ruby's tent.
You've found Ruby's journal. Read it (see INTERACT tab in your Inventory).
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.polish: Znalazłeś dziennik Ruby. Przeczytaj go (zajrzyj do zakładki INTERAKCJI w ekwipunku).
Conversation/0x0100000600014B7F/subtask_.belarusian: Ты знайшоў дзённік Рубі. Прачытай яго (загляні ў ўкладку ІНТЭРАКЦЫЙ у інвентары).

Conversation/0x0100000600014C27/Descript.english: Nice bed. You could sleep here -- later, once night has come.
Conversation/0x0100000600014C27/Descript.polish: Wygodne łóżko. Później, kiedy przyjdzie noc, możesz się tu przespać.
Conversation/0x0100000600014C27/Descript.belarusian: Зручнае ложка. Пазней, калі наступіць ноч, ты можаш тут пераспаць.

Conversation/0x01000006000168F9/Descript.english: Apparently there was a pissing match between Precinct 41 (yours) and Precinct 57 (Kim's). Ask Kim about this after the initial inspection of the dead body is done.
Conversation/0x01000006000168F9/Descript.polish: Wygląda na to, że między komisariatem 41. (twoim) a 57. (Kima) doszło do przepychanek. Spytaj o to Kima po zakończeniu wstępnych oględzin ciała.
Conversation/0x01000006000168F9/Descript.belarusian: Здаецца, паміж камісарыятамі 41 (твоім) і 57 (Кіма) адбыліся сутычкі. Спытай пра гэта Кіма пасля заканчэння папярэдняга агляду цела.

Conversation/0x0100000600016F1D/Descript.english: Photos of men in overalls, toting guns and Union placards.
Conversation/0x0100000600016F1D/Descript.polish: Zdjęcia ludzi w kombinezonach noszących broń i plakietki Związku.
Conversation/0x0100000600016F1D/Descript.belarusian: Фатаграфіі людзей у камбінезонах з зброяй і значкамі Звязу.

Conversation/0x0100000600016F24/Descript.english: You see hawthorn bushes outside. Hmm...
Conversation/0x0100000600016F24/Descript.polish: Widzisz na zewnątrz krzewy głogu. Hmm...

Conversation/0x0100000600017789/Descript.english: The swing is missing -- no one's been here for a long time.
Conversation/0x0100000600017789/Descript.polish: Huśtawka została zdjęta. Nikogo tu nie było od bardzo dawna.
Conversation/0x0100000600017789/Descript.belarusian: Качэлі былі знятыя. Тут нікога не было вельмі даўно.

Conversation/0x0100000600018A07/Descript.english: You see bottles in the bathtub: wine, beer and sweet liqueurs.
Conversation/0x0100000600018A07/Descript.polish: W wannie widzisz butelki: wino, piwo i słodkie likiery.
Conversation/0x0100000600018A07/Descript.belarusian: У ванне бачыш бутэлькі: віно, піва і салодкія лікёры.

Conversation/0x010000060001A4C7/Descript.english: The store on the other side is closed for the night. Come back tomorrow?
Conversation/0x010000060001A4C7/Descript.polish: Sklep po drugiej stronie jest już zamknięty. Może wróć jutro?
Conversation/0x010000060001A4C7/Descript.belarusian: Крама на другім баку ўжо зачынена. Можа, вярніся заўтра?

Conversation/0x010000060001A4D1/Descript.english: This tray is full of dice -- colourful polyhedral dice. Hundreds of them.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4D1/Descript.polish: Na tacy jest mnóstwo kości. Takich wielościennych i kolorowych. Są ich setki.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4D1/Descript.belarusian: На падносе шмат костак. Такіх шматгранных і каляровых. Іх сотні.

Conversation/0x010000060001A4D8/Descript.english: The candy dispenser has been repurposed to contain thousands of dice.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4D8/Descript.polish: Maszyna z cukierkami została przerobiona tak, by skrywać w sobie tysiące kości.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4D8/Descript.belarusian: Машына з цукеркамі была перароблена так, каб хаваць у сабе тысячы костак.

Conversation/0x010000060001A4E2/Descript.english: Old sports magazines, tucked away in a dark corner.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4E2/Descript.polish: Wciśnięte w mroczny zakamarek stare czasopisma sportowe.
Conversation/0x010000060001A4E2/Descript.belarusian: Упіхнутыя ў цёмны кут старых спартыўных часопісаў.

Conversation/0x010000060001A502/Descript.english: It is possible to determine the real cause of the hanged man's death -- before it's too late. You've just done it!
Conversation/0x010000060001A502/Descript.polish: Możliwe jest określenie prawdziwej przyczyny śmierci wisielca, nim będzie za późno. Właśnie ci się to udało!
Conversation/0x010000060001A502/Descript.belarusian: Магчыма вызначыць сапраўдную прычыну смерці павешанніка, перш чым будзе занадта позна. Ты толькі што гэта зрабіў!

Conversation/0x010000060001A502/Title.english: Find the bullet before you get fooled
Conversation/0x010000060001A502/Title.belarusian: Знайдзі патрон, перш чым цябе падмануць

Conversation/0x010000060001B561/Descript.english: A lonely cormorant surveys the sea, indifferent to your approach.
Conversation/0x010000060001B561/Descript.polish: Samotny kormoran wpatruje się w morze, obojętny na twoje przybycie.
Conversation/0x010000060001B561/Descript.belarusian: Адзінокі баклан глядзіць на мора, абыякавы да твайго прыбыцця.

Conversation/0x010000060001B5E7/Descript.english: That smoker up there could be a witness. Talk to him.
Conversation/0x010000060001B5E7/Descript.polish: Palacz na górze jest być może świadkiem. Porozmawiaj z nim.
Conversation/0x010000060001B5E7/Descript.belarusian: Курэц наверсе можа быць сведкам. Пагавары з ім.

Conversation/0x010000060001B5F2/Descript.english: There's a girl up there -- did she spill the paint?
Conversation/0x010000060001B5F2/Descript.polish: Tam na górze jest dziewczyna. To ona wylała farbę?
Conversation/0x010000060001B5F2/Descript.belarusian: Там наверсе ёсць дзяўчына. Гэта яна выліла фарбу?

Conversation/0x010000060001B835/Descript.english: Cold coffee and an ashtray that looks like a hedgehog.
Conversation/0x010000060001B835/Descript.polish: Zimna kawa i popielniczka w kształcie jeża.
Conversation/0x010000060001B835/Descript.belarusian: Халодная кава і попельніца ў форме вожыка.

Conversation/0x010000060001BB13/Descript.english: Complete silence. Whoever lives here isn't home.
Conversation/0x010000060001BB13/Descript.polish: Całkowita cisza. Ktokolwiek tu mieszka, nie ma go w domu.
Conversation/0x010000060001BB13/Descript.belarusian: Поўная цішыня. Хто б тут ні жыў, яго няма дома.

Conversation/0x010000060001C1C4/Descript.english: "Glory," says the graffito, "to the ghosts of us!"
Conversation/0x010000060001C1C4/Descript.polish: Graffito układa się w napis: „Chwała naszym duchom!”.
Conversation/0x010000060001C1C4/Descript.belarusian: Графіці ўкладваецца ў надпіс: «Слава нашым духам!».

Conversation/0x010000060001C7A8/Descript.english: Inside you hear the cosy sound of some kind of heater, sputtering.
Conversation/0x010000060001C7A8/Descript.polish: W środku słyszysz przyjemny odgłos dudnienia jakiegoś grzejnika.
Conversation/0x010000060001C7A8/Descript.belarusian: У сярэдзіне чуеш прыемны гук гудзення нейкага радыятара.

Conversation/0x010000060001D5A9/Descript.english: This door is closed for today. Time to put the kids to sleep.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5A9/Descript.polish: Te drzwi pozostaną już dziś zamknięte. Czas położyć dzieci spać.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5A9/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя дзверы застануцца сёння зачыненымі. Час класці дзяцей спаць.

Conversation/0x010000060001D5D1/Descript.english: A little black swallow circles above you. You hear it chirrup.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5D1/Descript.polish: Widzisz nad sobą krążącą po niebie małą jaskółkę. Słyszysz jej szczebiot.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5D1/Descript.belarusian: Ты бачыш над сабой маленькую ластаўку, што кружыць па небе. Чуеш яе шчабятанне.

Conversation/0x010000060001D5ED/Descript.english: The rear tire of a motor carriage adorns these reeds.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5ED/Descript.polish: Trzcina przyozdobiona jest tylną oponą powozu motorowego.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5ED/Descript.belarusian: Трысцё ўпрыгожана задняй шынай маторнай павозкі.

Conversation/0x010000060001D5F5/Descript.english: That's a Noland 'Vingt-Cinq', an unsuccessful model.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5F5/Descript.polish: To Noland Vingt-Cinq. Niezbyt udany model.
Conversation/0x010000060001D5F5/Descript.belarusian: Да Ноланда Вікт-Цянка. Не вельмі ўдалы мадэль.

Conversation/0x010000060001D5FC/Descript.english: Relax, it's not yours. You didn't crash every mc in Revachol. (Hopefully.)
Conversation/0x010000060001D5FC/Descript.polish: Spokojnie, to nie twoja. Nie rozbiłeś wszystkich powozów w Revacholu (miejmy nadzieję).
Conversation/0x010000060001D5FC/Descript.belarusian: Спакойна, гэта не твая. Ты не разбіў усе экіпажы ў Рэвашолі (спадзяемся).

Conversation/0x010000060001D71C/Descript.english: It's almost impossible to get a fire going this near to the ocean.
Conversation/0x010000060001D71C/Descript.polish: Tak blisko oceanu rozpalenie ognia graniczy z niemożliwością.
Conversation/0x010000060001D71C/Descript.belarusian: Так блізка да акіяна развядзенне агню мяжуе з немагчымасцю.

Conversation/0x010000060001D7B0/Descript.english: This section of the coast hasn't been used in decades.
Conversation/0x010000060001D7B0/Descript.polish: Ta część wybrzeża pozostaje porzucona od dziesięcioleci.
Conversation/0x010000060001D7B0/Descript.belarusian: Гэтая частка ўзбярэжжа застаецца пакінутай на працягу дзесяцігоддзяў.

Conversation/0x010000060001D7CE/Descript.english: People paid money to park here? No one would pay now...
Conversation/0x010000060001D7CE/Descript.polish: Ludzie płacili pieniądze, żeby tu zaparkować? Dziś nikt by nie dał złamanego réala.
Conversation/0x010000060001D7CE/Descript.belarusian: Людзі плацілі грошы, каб тут запаркаваць? Сёння ніхто не даў бы ламанага рэала.

Conversation/0x010000060001D837/Descript.english: You can imagine why. Calls become *terrible* sometimes.
Conversation/0x010000060001D837/Descript.polish: Nietrudno sobie wyobrazić przyczynę tego stanu rzeczy. Telefony czasami kończą się *fatalnie*.
Conversation/0x010000060001D837/Descript.belarusian: Няцяжка ўявіць сабе прычыну гэтага становішча. Тэлефоны часам заканчваюцца *фатальна*.

Conversation/0x010000060001D929/Descript.english: The wheel of a motor carriage has been discarded in the reeds.
Conversation/0x010000060001D929/Descript.polish: Ktoś rzucił w trzciny koło powozu motorowego.
Conversation/0x010000060001D929/Descript.belarusian: Хтось кінуў у трыснёг каля маторнага воза.

Conversation/0x010000060001D930/Descript.english: Relax, it's not yours. Not every crashed mc is yours. (Hopefully.)
Conversation/0x010000060001D930/Descript.polish: Spokojnie, to nie twoje. Nie wszystkie rozbite powozy należą do ciebie (miejmy nadzieję).
Conversation/0x010000060001D930/Descript.belarusian: Спакойна, гэта не тваё. Не ўсе разбітыя вазкі належаць табе (будзем спадзявацца).

Conversation/0x010000060001D936/Descript.english: A Noland "Vingt-Cinq", an unpopular model from the Thirties.
Conversation/0x010000060001D936/Descript.polish: To Noland Vingt-Cinq. Niezbyt popularny model z lat 30.
Conversation/0x010000060001D936/Descript.belarusian: Да Ноланд Вінгт-Сэнк. Не вельмі папулярная мадэль з 30-х гадоў.

Conversation/0x010000060001D949/Descript.english: Moonshine probably. Smells like tasty fermentation.
Conversation/0x010000060001D949/Descript.polish: To pewnie bimber. Pachnie smakowitą fermentacją.
Conversation/0x010000060001D949/Descript.belarusian: Гэта, напэўна, самагон. Пахне смачнай ферментацыяй.

Conversation/0x010000060001D999/Descript.english: Stop messing with the coin-viewer and hold on to something. The wind is so strong...
Conversation/0x010000060001D999/Descript.polish: Przestań grzebać przy lornetce na monety i złap się czegoś. Wiatr jest strasznie silny...
Conversation/0x010000060001D999/Descript.belarusian: Перастань капацца з манетамі і біноклям і за нешта ўхапіся. Вецер надта моцны...

Conversation/0x010000060001DF15/Descript.english: This is someone's home away from home. Just like yours.
Conversation/0x010000060001DF15/Descript.polish: To czyjś dom z dala od domu. Tak jak i twój.
Conversation/0x010000060001DF15/Descript.belarusian: Гэта дом кагосьці за межамі дома. Як і тваё.

Conversation/0x010000060001E3B3/Descript.english: Bark beetles? No, it looks intentional. Some long forgotten style.
Conversation/0x010000060001E3B3/Descript.polish: Korniki? Nie, to wygląda na zamierzone. Na jakiś dawno zapomniany styl.
Conversation/0x010000060001E3B3/Descript.belarusian: Караеды? Не, гэта выглядае на наўмыснае. На нейкі даўно забыты стыль.

Conversation/0x010000060001E3DF/Descript.english: A spider has spun its web around this wood-carved pillar.
Conversation/0x010000060001E3DF/Descript.polish: Wokół rzeźbionej w drewnie kolumny usnuł sobie sieć pająk.
Conversation/0x010000060001E3DF/Descript.belarusian: Вакол разьбяннай у дрэве калоны сплёў сабе сетку павук.

Conversation/0x010000060001E57C/Descript.english: The building before you housed the engine. Must have been a big one.
Conversation/0x010000060001E57C/Descript.polish: W budynku przed tobą znajdował się silnik. Musiał być wielki.
Conversation/0x010000060001E57C/Descript.belarusian: У будынку перад табой знаходзіўся рухавік. Ён павінен быў быць вялікім.

Conversation/0x010000060001E5DA/Descript.english: This relay tower coordinates boat traffic in the bay -- barely.
Conversation/0x010000060001E5DA/Descript.polish: Ta wieża przekaźnikowa zarządza – ledwo co – ruchem łodzi w zatoce.
Conversation/0x010000060001E5DA/Descript.belarusian: Гэта тэлекамунікацыйная вежа кіруе — ледзь-ледзь — рухам лодак у заліве.

Conversation/0x010000060001E6AD/Descript.english: These pots and plates are full of dust and spider-webs.
Conversation/0x010000060001E6AD/Descript.polish: Garnki i talerze pokryte są kurzem i pajęczynami.
Conversation/0x010000060001E6AD/Descript.belarusian: Гаршкі і талеркі пакрыты пылам і павуціннем.

Conversation/0x010000060001EBCC/Descript.english: You should come back here when it snows... A strange feeling. It passes quickly.
Conversation/0x010000060001EBCC/Descript.polish: Powinieneś tu wrócić, kiedy spadnie śnieg... Dziwne uczucie, które szybko przemija.
Conversation/0x010000060001EBCC/Descript.belarusian: Ты павінен вярнуцца сюды, калі выпадзе снег... Дзіўнае пачуццё, якое хутка мінае.

Conversation/0x010000060001EBD5/Descript.english: Looks like she's left something on the table...
Conversation/0x010000060001EBD5/Descript.polish: Zdaje się, że zostawiła coś na stole...
Conversation/0x010000060001EBD5/Descript.belarusian: Падаецца, яна пакінула нешта на стале...

Conversation/0x010000060001EF0D/Descript.english: These tyres are falling apart. They're at least 50 years old.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF0D/Descript.polish: Opony się rozsypują. Mają co najmniej 50 lat.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF0D/Descript.belarusian: Шыны распадаюцца. Ім не менш за 50 гадоў.

Conversation/0x010000060001EF3F/Descript.english: This great blast door must weigh over 10 tons. Rust peels off it.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF3F/Descript.polish: Te wielkie wrota muszą ważyć ponad 10 ton. Odpada od nich rdza.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF3F/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя вялікія вароты мусяць важыць больш за 10 тон. Ад іх адпадае ржа.

Conversation/0x010000060001EF5F/Descript.english: Not enough fuel. You'll have to look elsewhere.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF5F/Descript.polish: Za mało paliwa. Musisz poszukać gdzie indziej.
Conversation/0x010000060001EF5F/Descript.belarusian: Занадта мала паліва. Трэба пашукаць у іншым месцы.

Conversation/0x010000060001EF8B/Descript.english: You see her footprints on the water...
Conversation/0x010000060001EF8B/Descript.polish: Widzisz na wodzie ślady jej stóp...
Conversation/0x010000060001EF8B/Descript.belarusian: Бачыш на вадзе сляды яе ног...

Conversation/0x010000060001F321/Descript.english: Ouch, that leg hurts... maybe if you don't *run* it'll be okay?
Conversation/0x010000060001F321/Descript.polish: Au, boli ta noga... Może będzie lepiej, jeśli powstrzymasz się od *biegu*?
Conversation/0x010000060001F321/Descript.belarusian: Аў, баліць тая нага... Можа, будзе лепш, калі ўстрымаешся ад *бегу*?

Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Descript.english: The old guy in the uniform playing pétanque on the plaza -- he looks like a war veteran. Maybe he can tell you something about the may bells. Show them to him.
Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Descript.polish: Staruszek w mundurze grający na placu w petankę wygląda na weterana wojennego. Może on powie ci coś o konwaliach. Pokaż mu je.
Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Descript.belarusian: Стары чалавек у мундзіры, які гуляе на плошчы ў петанк, выглядае на ваеннага ветэрана. Магчыма, ён раскажа вам нешта пра канваліі. Пакажыце яму іх.

Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Title.english: Ask the pétanque player about may bells
Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Title.polish: Spytaj grającego w petankę o konwalie
Conversation/0x0100000700008F18/Title.belarusian: Спытай граючага ў петанку пра канваліі.

Conversation/0x010000070000ECB7/Descript.english: The photo you found in the nightwatchman's booth -- the one with a happy couple. Ask René about it, he looked uncharacteristically happy in the picture.
Conversation/0x010000070000ECB7/Descript.polish: Zdjęcie szczęśliwej pary znalezione w budce stróża nocnego. Spytaj o nie René, wygląda na nim na niezwykle jak na siebie radosnego.
Conversation/0x010000070000ECB7/Descript.belarusian: Фатаграфія шчаслівай пары знойдзена ў будцы начнога ахоўніка. Спытай пра яго Рэнэ, ён на ім выглядае надзвычай радасным, як для сябе.

Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/Descript.english: The gloves of the hanged man armour might still be around in the neighbourhood. Try to locate them.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/Descript.polish: Rękawice pancerza wisielca mogą wciąż być gdzieś w okolicy. Spróbuj je znaleźć.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/Descript.belarusian: Рукавіцы панцыра павешаніка могуць усё яшчэ быць дзесьці паблізу. Паспрабуй іх знайсці.

Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.english: A certain *Cindy the Skull* might know something about the victims armour. Ask her.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.polish: Niejaka *Cindy Czacha* może wiedzieć coś o pancerzu ofiary. Spytaj ją o niego.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.belarusian: Нейкая *Сіндзі Чахан* можа ведаць нешта пра даспехі ахвяры. Спытайся ў яе пра гэта.

Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.english: Ask the little girl in the fishing village, down the coast, who knows something about the armoured gloves.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z małą dziewczynką we wsi rybackiej na wybrzeżu. Wie ona coś o opancerzonych rękawicach.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з маленькай дзяўчынкай у рыбацкай вёсцы на ўзбярэжжы. Яна нешта ведае пра браняваныя пальчаткі.

Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.english: Ask Little Lily in the fishing village, down the coast, if she knows something about the armoured gloves.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.polish: Porozmawiaj z małą Lily we wsi rybackiej na wybrzeżu. Wie ona coś o opancerzonych rękawicach.
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.belarusian: Пагавары з маленькай Лілі ў рыбалоўнай вёсцы на ўзбярэжжы. Яна нешта ведае пра браняваных пальчатках.

Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.english: Lily said she hid the gloves in the sandcastle behind her house. Go get them!
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.polish: Lily powiedziała, że ukryła rękawice w zamku z piasku za jej domem. Ruszaj po nie!
Conversation/0x0100000700011FD6/subtask_.belarusian: Лілі сказала, што схавала пальчаткі ў замку з пяску за яе домам. Ідзі па іх!

Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Descript.english: You'll get so much more police work done, if you don't waste time chatting with old men. Just leave these two to their game.
Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Descript.polish: Odwalisz o wiele więcej policyjnej roboty, nie marnując czasu na pogawędki ze staruszkami. Daj tej dwójce grać w spokoju.
Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Descript.belarusian: Ты зробіш значна больш паліцэйскай працы, не марнуючы часу на размовы з пажылымі. Дай гэтай пары гуляць у спакоі.

Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Title.english: Do not talk to René and Gaston
Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Title.polish: Nie rozmawiaj z René i Gastonem
Conversation/0x010000070001AAD0/Title.belarusian: Не размаўляй з Рэнэ і Гастонам.

Conversation/0x010000070001AF37/Descript.english: Is that the Insulidian phasmid? Quick, try to catch it!
Conversation/0x010000070001AF37/Descript.polish: Czy to straszyk insulindiański? Szybko, spróbuj go złapać!
Conversation/0x010000070001AF37/Descript.belarusian: Ці гэта інсулаіндыйская павалока? Хутчэй, паспрабуй яго злавіць!

Conversation/0x010000080000122E/Descript.english: Water rushes below -- far down below.
Conversation/0x010000080000122E/Descript.polish: Na dole – daleko na dole – kłębi się woda.

Conversation/0x0100000800001235/Descript.english: Walk slow. It might be dangerous...

Conversation/0x010000080000123C/Descript.english: A firing slit. You can't see inside.
Conversation/0x010000080000123C/Descript.polish: Ambrazura. Nie jesteś w stanie nic zobaczyć w środku.
Conversation/0x010000080000123C/Descript.belarusian: Амбразура. Вы не можаце нічога ўбачыць унутры.

Conversation/0x0100000800001243/Descript.english: No way to jump down here without breaking a few bones.
Conversation/0x0100000800001243/Descript.polish: Nie ma mowy, żeby udało się stąd zeskoczyć, nie łamiąc kości.
Conversation/0x0100000800001243/Descript.belarusian: Няма мовы, каб удалося адсюль скочыць, не зламаўшы косці.

Conversation/0x0100000800002899/Descript.english: The ladder leads to a school of fish swimming in the kelp.
Conversation/0x0100000800002899/Descript.polish: Drabina wiedzie ku pływającej wśród wodorostów ławicy ryb.
Conversation/0x0100000800002899/Descript.belarusian: Лесьвіца вядзе да зграі рыб, якія плаваюць сярод водарасцяў.

Conversation/0x01000008000028CF/Descript.english: You can't see into the house from this angle.
Conversation/0x01000008000028CF/Descript.polish: Z tego kąta nie jesteś w stanie zajrzeć do domu.
Conversation/0x01000008000028CF/Descript.belarusian: З гэтага кута ты не зможаш зазірнуць у дом.

Conversation/0x01000008000028D5/Descript.english: A flower trough where nothing really grows. Maybe in Spring.
Conversation/0x01000008000028D5/Descript.polish: Klomb, na którym nic nie rośnie. Chyba że wiosną.
Conversation/0x01000008000028D5/Descript.belarusian: Клумба, на якой нічога не расце. Хіба што вясной.

Conversation/0x01000008000028DB/Descript.english: Hard to see the details -- the colors, all warm and welcoming, are cozy though.
Conversation/0x01000008000028DB/Descript.polish: Trudno dostrzec szczegóły, ciepłe i miłe kolory robią jednak wrażenie przytulności.
Conversation/0x01000008000028DB/Descript.belarusian: Цяжка заўважыць дэталі, але цёплыя і прыемныя колеры ствараюць уражанне ўтульнасці.

Conversation/0x01000008000028E1/Descript.english: What are *these* doing in the fish?

Conversation/0x01000008000028ED/Descript.english: A bottle, drained of all its booze, is frozen to the ice.
Conversation/0x01000008000028ED/Descript.polish: Pozbawiona procentowej zawartości butelka przymarzła do lodu.
Conversation/0x01000008000028ED/Descript.belarusian: Пазбаўленая працэнтнага зместу бутэлька прымерзла да лёду.

Conversation/0x01000008000028FA/Descript.english: There's something stashed beneath the boat.

Conversation/0x0100000800002970/Descript.english: Rain has washed up the foundations and it's melting away in the sea breeze.
Conversation/0x0100000800002970/Descript.polish: Deszcz podmył mu fundamenty, przez co rozsypuje się powoli w morskiej bryzie.
Conversation/0x0100000800002970/Descript.belarusian: Дажджы падмылі яму падмуркі, з-за чаго ён паступова развальваецца ў марской блюзе.

Conversation/0x0100000800002977/Descript.english: The door is not only barred shut -- it is inaccessible.
Conversation/0x0100000800002977/Descript.polish: Drzwi są nie tylko zablokowane, ale też niedostępne.
Conversation/0x0100000800002977/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы не толькі заблакіраваныя, але і недаступныя.

Conversation/0x010000080000297E/Descript.english: There's absolutely no way in through this door.
Conversation/0x010000080000297E/Descript.polish: Nie ma żadnego przejścia przez te drzwi.
Conversation/0x010000080000297E/Descript.belarusian: Няма ніякага праходу праз гэтыя дзверы.

Conversation/0x0100000800002985/Descript.english: A buoy bobs in the water. The number on it says: 11.
Conversation/0x0100000800002985/Descript.polish: Na wodzie unosi się boja. Widnieje na niej liczba 11.
Conversation/0x0100000800002985/Descript.belarusian: На вадзе плавае буя. На ім нанесена лічба 11.

Conversation/0x010000080000298C/Descript.english: Could this be the buoy Klaasje told you about?
Conversation/0x010000080000298C/Descript.polish: Czy to może być boja, o której mówiła ci Klaasje?
Conversation/0x010000080000298C/Descript.belarusian: Ці можа гэта быць буя, пра якую табе казала Клаасе?

Conversation/0x0100000800002993/Descript.english: No boat in the boat house today.
Conversation/0x0100000800002993/Descript.polish: Dziś w szopie nie ma łodzi.

Conversation/0x010000080000299A/Descript.english: Ancient paint is peeling off the roof of this shaded bench, covered in rust.
Conversation/0x010000080000299A/Descript.polish: Z zadaszenia pokrytej rdzą ławki schodzi płatami niesamowicie stara farba.
Conversation/0x010000080000299A/Descript.belarusian: Са зялезнай лаўкі з іржавым пакрыццём грудамі аблузваецца вельмі старая фарба.

Conversation/0x01000008000029A1/Descript.english: An old ticket-taker booth. No longer in operation.
Conversation/0x01000008000029A1/Descript.polish: Stara budka biletera. Od dawna nieużywana.
Conversation/0x01000008000029A1/Descript.belarusian: Старая білетная будачка. Даўно не выкарыстоўваецца.

Conversation/0x01000008000029A8/Descript.english: These soggy logs smell of ignition fluid -- still they won't light up.
Conversation/0x01000008000029A8/Descript.polish: Te wilgotne kłody czuć podpałką, mimo to jednak nie chcą się zapalić.
Conversation/0x01000008000029A8/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя вільготныя драўляныя палены адчуваюцца як падпалька, але тым не менш не хочуць запальвацца.

Conversation/0x01000008000029B6/Descript.english: Someone must have worked hard to smash the plastic dome.
Conversation/0x01000008000029B6/Descript.polish: Ktoś musiał się bardzo napracować, żeby rozbić tę plastikową kopułę.
Conversation/0x01000008000029B6/Descript.belarusian: Хтось мусіў вельмі папрацаваць, каб разбіць гэтую пластыкавую купал.

Conversation/0x01000008000029BD/Descript.english: A drawbridge -- for ease of transportation across the ice.
Conversation/0x01000008000029BD/Descript.belarusian: Разводны мост, які палягчае пераход праз лёд.

Conversation/0x01000008000029C4/Descript.english: These rusty gears used to turn the whole machine.
Conversation/0x01000008000029C4/Descript.polish: Te zardzewiałe tryby obracały kiedyś całą maszyną.
Conversation/0x01000008000029C4/Descript.belarusian: Гэтыя заржавелыя механізмы калісьці рухалі ўсю машыну.

Conversation/0x01000008000029CB/Descript.english: A rusted, broken control box for the radio relay tower.
Conversation/0x01000008000029CB/Descript.polish: Zardzewiały, zepsuty panel sterowania wieżą przekaźnika radiowego.
Conversation/0x01000008000029CB/Descript.belarusian: Іржаўлены, сапсаваны пульт кіравання вежай радыётранслятара.

Conversation/0x01000008000029D2/Descript.english: Tiny inlets there -- off in the far distance, where the posts trail toward...
Conversation/0x01000008000029D2/Descript.polish: Tam, w oddali, gdzie wiodą słupy, widnieją małe zatoczki...
Conversation/0x01000008000029D2/Descript.belarusian: Там, удалечыні, дзе вядуць слупы, віднеюцца малыя затокі...

Conversation/0x01000008000029E0/Descript.english: Another power box. It charges nothing now. It's empty.
Conversation/0x01000008000029E0/Descript.polish: Kolejna skrzynka zasilająca. Tyle że teraz niczego nie zasila. Jest pusta.
Conversation/0x01000008000029E0/Descript.belarusian: Яшчэ адна скрыня сілкавання. Толькі зараз яна нічога не сілкуе. Яна пустая.

Conversation/0x01000008000029E7/Descript.english: A big wine canister -- it's open and empty.
Conversation/0x01000008000029E7/Descript.polish: Duży pojemnik na wino. Otwarty i pusty.
Conversation/0x01000008000029E7/Descript.belarusian: Вялікі кантэйнер для віна. Адкрыты і пусты.

Conversation/0x01000008000029F5/Descript.english: The boardwalk rises to your south. It casts its long shadow over you.
Conversation/0x01000008000029F5/Descript.polish: Na południe od ciebie wznosi się promenada. Rzuca na ciebie swój długi cień.
Conversation/0x01000008000029F5/Descript.belarusian: На поўдзень ад цябе ўзвышаецца праменад. Ён кідае на цябе сваю доўгую цень.

Conversation/0x01000008000029FC/Descript.english: You feel the shadow of a very large building fall on you.
Conversation/0x01000008000029FC/Descript.polish: Czujesz, jak spowija cię cień bardzo dużego budynku.
Conversation/0x01000008000029FC/Descript.belarusian: Адчуваеш, як цябе ахутвае цень вельмі вялікага будынка.

Conversation/0x0100000800002A03/Descript.english: The ice here is thick enough to walk on.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A03/Descript.polish: Lód jest tu wystarczająco gruby, by po nim chodzić.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A03/Descript.belarusian: Лёд тут дастаткова тоўсты, каб па ім хадзіць.

Conversation/0x0100000800002A0A/Descript.english: It's a long way down to your death from here. 20 metres at least.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A0A/Descript.polish: Droga w dół ku śmierci jest tutaj długa. Ma co najmniej 20 metrów.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A0A/Descript.belarusian: Дарога ўніз да смерці тут доўгая. Яна мае як мінімум 20 метраў.

Conversation/0x0100000800002A11/Descript.english: The boards crack dangerously as you run. Be careful here.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A11/Descript.polish: Deski skrzypią niebezpiecznie, kiedy biegniesz. Zachowaj ostrożność.
Conversation/0x0100000800002A11/Descript.belarusian: Паркетні дошкі небяспечна рыпяць, калі вы бегаеце. Будзьце асцярожныя.

Conversation/0x0100000B0000400A/Descript.english: Looks like she left a nice long stub in the ashtray. It's still smoking.
Conversation/0x0100000B0000400A/Descript.polish: Zostawiła w popielniczce bardzo ładny, długi niedopałek. Wciąż się dymi.
Conversation/0x0100000B0000400A/Descript.belarusian: Яна пакінула ў попельніцы вельмі прыгожы, доўгі недапалак. Ён ўсё яшчэ дыміцца.

Conversation/0x0100000F00006E2C/Descript.english: Rhetoric tells you it's time to bone up on dialectical materialism and get organized.
Conversation/0x0100000F00006E2C/Descript.polish: Retoryka podpowiada ci, że czas zapoznać się z materializmem dialektycznym i zacząć organizować się w związki.
Conversation/0x0100000F00006E2C/Descript.belarusian: Рыторыка падказвае табе, што час пазнаёміцца з дыялектычным матэрыялізмам і пачаць арганізоўвацца ў саюзы.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/Descript.english: You can't build communism alone. It's time to join your revolutionary brethren, develop your political consciousness, and put Mazovian theory into practice. But where have all the communists gone?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/Descript.polish: Samodzielnie komunizmu nie zbudujesz. Czas dołączyć do braci rewolucjonistów, rozwinąć swoją świadomość polityczną i obrócić teorię mazowską w praktykę. Ale gdzie się podziali wszyscy komuniści?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/Descript.belarusian: Самастойна камунізм не пабудуеш. Час далучыцца да братоў-рэвалюцыянераў, развіць сваю палітычную свядомасць і ператварыць мазавецкую тэорыю ў практыку. Але куды зніклі ўсе камуністы?

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.english: Roam the streets to sniff out some comrades.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.polish: Spróbuj wywęszyć na ulicach jakichś towarzyszy.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.belarusian: Паспрабуй вынюхаць на вуліцах нейкіх таварышаў.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.english: Find the secret passphrase to Steban's meeting.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.polish: Poznaj tajne hasło wstępu na spotkanie Stebana.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.belarusian: Даведайцеся сакрэтны пароль для ўваходу на сустрэчу Стэбана.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.english: Find out more about this 'ideólogo' Mañana mentioned.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.polish: Dowiedz się więcej o tym „ideólogo”, o którym wspominał Mañana.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.belarusian: Даведайся больш пра гэтага «ідэолага», пра якога згадваў Маньяна.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.english: Attend Steban's meeting after 22.00 at the Capeside apartments.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.polish: Weź udział w spotkaniu Stebana po 22:00 w Apartamentowcu Półwysep.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.belarusian: Вазьмі ўдзел у сустрэчы Стэбана пасля 22:00 у Апартаментаўцы Палвостраў.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.english: Return to the group for discussion.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.polish: Wróć do grupy i przedyskutuj lekturę.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000707C/subtask_.belarusian: Вярніцеся ў групу і абмяркуйце чытанне.

Conversation/0x0100000F000070BA/Descript.english: Rhetoric smells a communist around here. Part of the Communist Dream Quest
Conversation/0x0100000F000070BA/Descript.polish: Retoryka wyczuwa tu gdzieś komunistę. To część zadania Komunistyczny sen
Conversation/0x0100000F000070BA/Descript.belarusian: Рыторыка адчувае тут дзе-небудзь камуніста. Гэта частка задання Камуністычны сон.

Conversation/0x0100000F000072B8/Descript.english: Door leading to the Storage Room where the Secret Communist Meeting takes place. (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F000072B8/Descript.polish: Drzwi wiodące do magazynu, w którym odbywa się tajne spotkanie komunistów (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F000072B8/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы, якія вядуць у склад, дзе адбываецца сакрэтная сустрэча камуністаў (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ КАМУНІСТЫЧНЫ СОН).

Conversation/0x0100000F00007585/Descript.english: The Student Communist and his underground reading group (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F00007585/Descript.polish: Student komunista i jego nielegalna grupa czytelnicza (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F00007585/Descript.belarusian: Студэнт камуніст і яго незаконная чытацкая група (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАЧЫ КАМУНІСТЫЧНЫ СОН).

Conversation/0x0100000F00007989/Descript.english: Rhetoric smells a communist around here. Part of the Communist Dream Quest
Conversation/0x0100000F00007989/Descript.polish: Retoryka wyczuwa tu gdzieś komunistę. To część zadania Komunistyczny sen
Conversation/0x0100000F00007989/Descript.belarusian: Рыторыка адчувае недзе тут камуніста. Гэта частка задання Камуністычны сон

Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.english: Vol. 1 No. 2 of *La Fumée*, Martinaise's leading quarterly journal of radical Mazovian thought (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.polish: Wyd. 1, nr 2 *La Fumée*, wiodącego martyneskiego kwartalnika wyznawców radykalnej myśli mazowskiej (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F00008436/Descript.belarusian: Вяд. 1, нумар 2 *La Fumée*, вядучага марцынескага квартальнага выдання прыхільнікаў радыкальнай мазавецкай думкі (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАННЯ КАМУНІСЦЫЧНЫ СОН).

Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.english: An Introduction to the Theories of Ignus Nilsen (PART OF THE COMMUNIST DREAM QUEST)
Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.polish: Wprowadzenie do teroii Ignusa Nilsena (CZĘŚĆ ZADANIA KOMUNISTYCZNY SEN).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000843D/Descript.belarusian: Уводзіны ў тэорыю Ігнуса Нільсэна (ЧАСТКА ЗАДАЧЫ КАМУНІСТЫЧНЫ СОН).

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.english: Empathy tells you it's time to take responsibility... by convening a committee to spread responsibility around.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.polish: Empatia podpowiada ci, że czas wziąć na siebie odpowiedzialność... utworzenia komitetu, który pozwoli rozmyć odpowiedzialność.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BC86/Descript.belarusian: Эмпатыя падказвае табе, што час узяць на сябе адказнасць... стварэння камітэта, які дазволіць размыліць адказнасць.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.english: Things down here are a *mess*. Someone really ought to do something about it. First, though, you and some other moralists should probably form a committee to decide whose job it is.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.polish: Bajzel tu jest *niesamowity*. Ktoś naprawdę powinien coś z tym zrobić. Najpierw jednak powinieneś chyba wraz z innymi moralistami stworzyć komitet, który zdecyduje, czyje to będzie zadanie.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/Descript.belarusian: Тут сапраўдны *беспарадак*. Хтосьці сапраўды павінен нешта з гэтым зрабіць. Аднак спачатку ты, відаць, разам з іншымі маралістамі павінен стварыць камітэт, які вырашыць, чыя гэта будзе задача.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Form a committee of moralists to assign responsibility. Kim might know where to start?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Stwórz komitet moralistów, który będzie przydzielał obowiązki. Może Kim będzie wiedział, od czego zacząć?
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Ствары камітэт маралістаў, які будзе прызначаць абавязкі. Можа, Кім будзе ведаць, з чаго пачаць?

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should keep your eyes peeled for moralists (may take a while).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś rozglądać się za moralistami (może to nieco zająć).
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа, што ты павінен аглядацца на маралістаў (гэта можа заняць трохі часу).

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should look for the Sunday Friend. The Smoker on the Balcony might know where he is.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś poszukać Niedzielnego Przyjaciela. Balkonowy palacz może wiedzieć, gdzie go szukać.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа, што ты павінен пашукаць Нядзельнага Сябра. Балконны курэц можа ведаць, дзе яго шукаць.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Kim says you should talk with Trant Heidelstam.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Kim mówi, że powinieneś porozmawiać z Trantem Heidelstamem.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Кім кажа, што табе варта пагутарыць з Трантам Хэйдэльстамам.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: The Smoker says his Sunday Friend has gone for a stroll along the coast.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Palacz twierdzi, że jego Niedzielny Przyjaciel udał się na spacer wzdłuż wybrzeża.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Курэц сцвярджае, што яго Нядзельны Сябар адправіўся на прагулку ўздоўж узбярэжжа.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Find someone with technical expertise to contact the Coalition.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź kogoś, kto będzie miał wiedzę techniczną niezbędną, by nawiązać kontakt z Koalicją.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзіце таго, хто будзе мець неабходныя тэхнічныя веды, каб устанавіць кантакт з Кааліцыяй.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Inspect the antenna at Land's End.
Come up with a suitable location for a giant antenna.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź odpowiednie miejsce dla wielkiej anteny.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзіце адпаведнае месца для вялікай антэны.

Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.english: Find a working transceiver and return to the church.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.polish: Znajdź działający transiwer i wróć do kościoła.
Conversation/0x0100000F0000BEC9/subtask_.belarusian: Знайдзі працуючы трансіўэр і вярніся ў касцёл.

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/Descript.english: No more messing around. It's time to get rich for real! Just play the market right and you'll be a millionaire by the end of the week. Then you can get what your heart desires. Whatever it is...

Conversation/0x0100000F00011829/subtask_.english: Find a starving artist and become their patron.

Conversation/0x01000016000089F7/Descript.english: Garte + Sylvie = ?? Something's going on here. You need to help a brother out with his love-woes. Go to Garte and give him some solid advice. Tell him how it *is* with women.

Conversation/0x0100001600008A31/Title.english: Where is the rest of the armour?

Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Descript.polish: Na biegnącej wzdłuż wybrzeża promenadzie Martinaise leży ciało. Wróć do niego z porucznikiem i zdecyduj, co z nim zrobić.

Conversation/0x0100002100000EBD/Title.english: Return to the dead body with Kim

Conversation/0x01000021000020E9/Descript.english: Before you, a drawbridge. It can only be lowered from the other side.

Conversation/0x01000021000020FB/Descript.polish: Po prawej widzisz białobrzuchego kormorana, który przygląda ci się podejrzliwie.

Conversation/0x010000210000223E/Descript.english: Don't run, okay? Take it slow when exploring the apartment. Be respectful.
Conversation/0x010000210000223E/Descript.polish: Nie biegaj, dobrze? Krocz z godnością, badając mieszkanie. Okaż szacunek.

Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.english: There are rumours that the previous forewoman of the Union just disappeared, right before the Claires took over. Her daughter called in on the election eve and said she wasn't running any more -- or coming to work. What happened?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.polish: Krążą pogłoski, że dawna przywódczyni Związku po prostu zniknęła tuż przed tym, jak władzę przejęli Claire'owie. Jej córka poinformowała w przeddzień wyborów, że nie będzie ona już startować na ten urząd. Ani przychodzić do pracy. Co się stało?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Descript.belarusian: Ходзяць чуткі, што былая лідарка Саюза проста знікла неўзабаве да таго, як уладу захапілі Клэры. Яе дачка паведаміла ў пераддзень выбараў, што яна больш не будзе вылучацца на гэтую пасаду. І не будзе прыходзіць на працу. Што здарылася?

Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Title.english: What happened to the previous forewoman?
Conversation/0x0100002100002775/Title.polish: Co się stało z dawną przywódczynią?

Conversation/0x0100002700000E84/Descript.english: A sign reads: "Mess hall reserved for Union members. Doors open: 16:00."

Conversation/0x0100002700000E84/Descript.belarusian: Надпіс на знаку гаворыць: «Сталоўка зарэзерваваная для членаў Саюза. Адкрыццё а 16:00».

Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.english: Inside you catch a glimpse of Union paraphernalia: a strike poster, some red pennants.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.polish: W środku dostrzegasz materiały związkowe: plakat strajkowy, czerwone proporczyki.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E8C/Descript.belarusian: Унутры ты заўважаеш прафсаюзныя матэрыялы: страйкавы плакат, чырвоныя сцяжкі.

Conversation/0x0100002700000E95/Descript.polish: Dystrybutor na wodę. Ku powierzchni wznosi się duży bąbel powietrza.

Conversation/0x0100002700000E9D/Descript.english: The menu has been wiped clean. Only the word MONDAY is written on it.
Conversation/0x0100002700000E9D/Descript.polish: Menu zostało starte. Pozostało tylko słowo PONIEDZIAŁEK.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EAC/Descript.english: The soft purr of an electric juicer comes from the kitchen. Someone is working.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EAC/Descript.polish: Z kuchni dobiega pomruk elektrycznej wyciskarki do soków. Ktoś tam pracuje.

Conversation/0x0100002700000EBC/Descript.polish: Drzwi są zaryglowane. Na znaku widnieje napis: „Do 13:00 kuchnia zarezerwowana dla personelu”.
Conversation/0x0100002700000EBC/Descript.belarusian: Дзверы зачынены на замок. На знаку напісана: «Да 13:00 кухня зарэзервавана для персаналу».

Conversation/0x0100002F000096F8/Title.polish: Skontaktuj się z lazaretem swojego komisariatu

Conversation/0x0100002F0001008A/subtask_.english: First you should find the vehicle the joyrider used in their escapades.
